description: An applied biological ligand or protein is associated with a statistically significant increase in expression of the target gene in LINCS L1000 / Connectivity Map. The source Gene encodes the administered ligand, and the target Gene is the responding gene.

common_properties.name: z_score
common_properties.description: Signed Stouffer consensus z-score for the ligand–target pair; positive values indicate up-regulation.
common_properties.notes: Carries magnitude; sign is consistent with the edge's up/down type

common_properties.name: p_value
common_properties.description: Bonferroni-corrected two-tailed normal p-value, corrected separately for each ligand and target-gene tier; retained pairs pass significance at α = 0.05.

common_properties.name: tier
common_properties.description: Target-gene evidence tier: landmark genes are directly measured, while BING denotes well-inferred non-landmark genes.

common_properties.name: n_signatures
common_properties.description: Number of pooled expression signatures combined into the ligand consensus; an indicator of supporting evidence.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Source attribution for the ligand perturbation evidence.
common_properties.notes: Single-element list under this source; list, never scalar

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time when the edge was created or last updated.

source_contributions.scope: Biological ligand/protein treatments (trt_lig), using human target genes that are directly measured landmarks or well-inferred non-landmark BING genes. Poorly inferred non-BING genes are excluded. Both endpoint genes must be represented in SPOKE. Self-edges are retained as autoregulation; no touchstone restriction is applied.
source_contributions.description: Evidence comes from GEO series GSE92742 and GSE70138. All preparations and expression signatures for a ligand are pooled across cell lines, doses, times, and both series into one consensus profile using correlation-weighted Stouffer integration. Significance is assessed separately for landmark and non-landmark BING target genes. All significant landmark targets are retained; significant BING targets are limited to the top 1,000 per ligand by corrected p-value.
